description.name: Entry
description.text:
Tactical Awoken Mode & +500 ATK to user
Tactical Awoken Mode: Ice/Lightning Ability Boost, Triplecast Ice/Lightning, Unlimited Ice/Lightning Hones, Cap Break Level 1 to Ice/Lightning Abilities, Ice/Lightning Ability Damage +30% & ATB Speed x1.1 to Ice/Lightning Abilities; Ends after using 8 Ice/Lightning abilities
TP Max: AOE Ice/NE or Lightning/NE ranged physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1 under En-Ice or En-Lightning

description.name: War-Awoken Mist Flash (Weapon Skill)
description.text:
Single-target Ice/Lightning/NE piercing ranged physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant ATB 1 & Instant Cast 1 to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & ATB Speed x1.2 to Ice/Lightning Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold if target has at least 0/40% Imperil Ice/Lightning
WS Blue: Imperil Ice/Lightning 30% to all enemies
WS Gold: DeProtect 20% to all enemies
